note: Niue's bank is Kiwibank, a New Zealand bank, through a local agency: Kiwibank's own release of 13 November 2023 (read 2026-10-30) says it has provided designated transactional banking services to all residents of Niue since 2013, Niue Commercial Enterprises Limited appointed by Kiwibank as a Local Services Provider for the agency services, and serves over 1,400 Niueans on the island; the Government of Niue's joint release of 24 July 2026 speaks of Kiwibank customers in Niue and of products offered locally via the Kiwibank agency branch. A Kiwibank account is numbered in New Zealand's form: Kiwibank's own page (read 2026-10-30) gives the bank's two digits (38), the branch's four (9000 to 9499; the branch name is Wellington wherever the account was opened), the account's seven and the suffix's two. So an account held in Niue is numbered as one in New Zealand, and the file follows New Zealand's form. Reading to check: no source read shows a Niue customer's own account number, and the Niue Development Bank (a lender) wasn't read on whether it numbers deposit accounts of its own.

sources.title: Kiwibank, Niue renews banking services relationship with Kiwibank (media release, 13 November 2023)
sources.said: Kiwibank first started providing designated transactional banking services to all residents of Niue in 2013. As part of this process, the Government of Niue established Niue Commercial Enterprises Limited which was then appointed by Kiwibank Limited as a Local Services Provider to assist in providing local agency services. ... Kiwibank currently serves over 1,400 Niueans on the island

sources.title: Government of Niue, Kiwibank and the Niue Development Bank, joint media release: More Kiwibank savings options coming to Niue (24 July 2026)
sources.said: Under the updated agreement, eligible Kiwibank customers in Niue will soon be able to access Kiwibank Term Deposits and Notice Saver Accounts. ... allowing the Niue Development Bank to make these products available locally via the Kiwibank agency branch.

sources.title: Kiwibank, Where to find your account number
sources.said: The first two digits tell you the bank – Kiwibank is 38. ... The next four digits tell you the branch – for Kiwibank this ranges anywhere between 9000-9499. ... it'll be 'Wellington', no matter where you opened your account. ... The next seven digits tell you the account number. ... The last two digits tell you the account suffix
